messages:
megan: heads-up: p-12a started seeing repeated OOMs after the 02:00 kernel autotune deploy. alloc failures + selector picked the high-workspace path.
sam: ok. quick mitigation: flip kernel selector to conservative for that pool?
pranav: short game plan:
1) switch kernel selector to conservative
2) clamp max_workspace_bytes -> 512MB
3) enable allocator soft-reserve reclaim
4) throttle route-level tokens/batch
5) lower KV cache TTL for that pool
sam: CLI to flip (ops-api):
```
curl -X POST "$RUNTIME_API/pools/p-12a/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{\"kernel_selector\":\"conservative\",\"max_workspace_bytes\":536870912}'
```
toni: patch for KV TTL:
```
PATCH /pools/p-12a/cache
{\"kv_ttl_seconds\":30}
```
pranav: breaker rules to apply immediately (route-level):
- max_input_tokens: 2048
- max_batch_tokens: 4096
- per_request_timeout_ms: 2000
- reject_large: 429
also add model fallback: route -> quantized-1.1 if memory pressure
ryan: sampler profiling during spike (100ms):
```
[2026-03-12T02:03:12Z] kernel=A2_high_ws cpu_ms=12 alloc_peak=1.52GB kv_cache=380MB
[2026-03-12T02:03:13Z] kernel=A2_high_ws alloc_fail requested=1.6GB free=120MB
```
megan: executing changes in this order: selector -> workspace clamp -> kv ttl -> soft-reserve reclaim -> breaker rules. will monitor GPU mem and alloc histogram.
sam: note: prefer config flips first; restarts are last-resort (will kill inflight sessions)
toni: quick reclaim command if immediate headroom needed: `allocatorctl --pool p-12a reclaim --soft` then `sudo systemctl restart inference-worker` (graceful)
pranav: add emergency traffic reroute: route noisy/long sequences to hosted-fallback-compact-model
sam: follow-up: add a perf test gate so autotuner doesn't pick high-workspace kernels until sample distribution stabilizes
megan: ack. will file a postmortem + autotuner guardrails + small reproducer load test. monitoring alert: escalate if alloc tail > 90th pct for 5m
infra-bot: @channel p-12a config changes recorded by megan at 1778002345
megan: closing once metrics stable for 15m :thumbsup:
